title: Online Label-Free Gradient Matching for Continual Language Model Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.03496v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models in customer-facing products must be continually updated, since the data they serve shifts over time. As retraining on the full accumulated data is impractical, each update should instead run on a small set of examples carrying the training signal of all data seen so far. The strongest current methods build this set by gradient matching, which synthesizes examples whose training gradients match those of the full data. However, they require ground-truth labels, run once on a fixed snapshot rather than on a growing stream, and are slow on large data. We introduce \textbf{OLGA}, which lifts these limitations. It distills unlabeled data by drawing the gradient matching targets from the model's own next-token predictions. Across five text classification benchmarks with phi-1.5, it improves accuracy by 10 percentage points over the strongest selection baseline using as few as five examples. translated_title: 面向持续语言模型训练的在线无标签梯度匹配
translated_abstract: 面向客户的产品中的语言模型必须持续更新，因为它们所服务的数据会随时间发生变化。由于在全部累积数据上重新训练是不切实际的，每次更新应该在一小组能够携带迄今为止所见全部数据训练信号的样本上进行。当前最强的方法通过梯度匹配来构建这样的数据集，即合成训练梯度与全部数据梯度相匹配的样本。然而，这些方法需要真实标签，只能对固定快照运行一次而无法处理不断增长的数据流，并且在大型数据上速度缓慢。我们提出了OLGA，它克服了这些局限。它通过从模型自身的下一个词预测中提取梯度匹配目标，来蒸馏无标签数据。在五个文本分类基准测试中使用phi-1.5模型，仅使用五个样本，OLGA的准确率就比最强的数据选择基线提高了10个百分点。OLGA还能蒸馏在线数据流……
tldr: OLGA提出了一种在线无标签的梯度匹配数据蒸馏方法，利用模型自身的下一个词预测作为梯度匹配目标，摆脱了对真实标签的依赖，能够持续处理不断增长的数据流，在持续语言模型训练中显著优于现有需要标签的方法。
en_tdlr: OLGA introduces an online, label-free gradient matching method for continual language model training that distills unlabeled data by using the model's own next-token predictions as gradient matching targets, outperforming label-dependent baselines by 10 percentage points on text classification benchmarks.
